registered_after: primary canonical and counterfactual evaluation, before any verbal or vocabulary-head transfer scoring
gate: original direct model and 80-update terminal continuation clear all trained-depth installation floors
sample: first 96 canonical development map IDs at requested hops 1, 2 and 3
categorical: render the map as Room sentences, omit hop count for recurrent, retain requested depth for dense
lm: same Room sentences and explicit requested hops for all arms, end with Destination (one digit): followed by one space; one unrestricted greedy token
arms: direct installation K=1 and requested K
after terminal continuation K=1 and requested K
retention: first four documents per available domain of source-disjoint v3_retention development, fixed K including both true K=1 and K=3 for recurrent weights
selection: descriptive only; no fresh confirmation, architecture selection or transfer fine-tuning
